items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: sometimes like a Jack Wilson song or something, it'd be too high or something, and I'd put it in his key.

ctx.x: He'd come to my place I lived by myself.

And I said, hey, this record player there, and he'd bring the 45, or the album or whatever. And what I'd have to do, I'd have to, sometimes like a Jack Wilson song or something, it'd be too high or something, and I'd put it in his key. Yeah, I'd put it in the key, come for him to sing. And I'd arrange it. And it'd always come out fine, you know. And man, we got so popular. But them first few rehearsals had real problems, because they wasn't up on their reading, they hadn't read in so long. And then after the more…
You know where Safari was? Yeah, Safari was.
